750970101.text: Huh? Is it just Paimon, or are the Statues of The Seven in Natlan a bit weird?

750970102.text: Shouldn't it be more... intense the first time you touch it? Like, there's a "schwing"-y sound, that kinda feeling?

750970104.text: But it really is kinda strange...

750970108.text: Hmm, how should Paimon put it... Well, she always felt that before, there'd be a stronger connection established when you touched Statues...

750970109.text: This time, it feels more like hitting a switch, like all that happened when you touched the Statue was that it lit up.

750970110.text: Right, right! Before, when you touched the Statues, you could feel the elemental power. But this time...

750970111.text: Does it have that Pyro feel, all lively and intense?

750970106.text: Oh! So you just forgot to "schwing" this time, then? Well, next time, try to pay more attention...

750970107.text: AS IF! You better add your own sound effects every time you touch a Statue of The Seven!

750970201.text: ...Yeah, it's definitely off. You still can't get elemental power from the Statue of The Seven?

750970202.text: Geez! Just what's with the Statues?

750970204.text: But it totally glowed when you touched it!

750970205.text: Hey! C'mon, Statue of The Seven... Are you doing your job properly?

750970207.text: Now you mention it, it does sound like Natlan's constantly been affected by the influence of the Abyss... Could that be why?

750970301.text: Hehe, that's the way it should be! That's the kind of stable connection with the Statue of The Seven we're looking for.

750970302.text: So that issue we were having before was due to that baddie in the Night Kingdom, huh? The Statue of The Seven sure must've been having a hard time back then... Great job, Statue!

750970303.text: Though, it's not like you could've granted the power to resonate with Pyro even if you wanted to...

750970304.text: Yeah, that happened while I was fighting alongside the Pyro Archon...

750970305.text: Yeah, Paimon was super scared then... But as it turned out, you were too strong for that!

750970306.text: Either way, it's great that we managed to get rid of all those Abyss monsters and restore the Statues!
